verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference API provider. Operating it through natural-language commands is a fair axis, since such a product could offer a conversational console or agent for managing keys, usage and models. The evidence shows only that it serves models which process natural-language prompts, and that it can act as a backend for Claude Code and Codex. Its llms.txt and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks. None of this is a documented way to operate the product itself with natural-language commands.
